en: A black‑and‑white view of a formal public garden with wide gravel paths, neatly edged flower beds full of blooming plants, trimmed lawns and vine‑covered pergolas with white wooden benches. A woman in early 20th‑century clothing, wearing a long dark skirt and light blouse and holding a hat, stands beside one of the flower beds. In the hazy background are scattered trees and faint outlines of larger buildings or towers beyond the park.
